issue.title: Update docs to new plugin archicture
issue.body:
This PR updates docs to match up with https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/pull/188

Examples and most of guide done (though there will be further comments inline). This also includes docs from https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/pull/242 (not yet merged). Writing plugins and extensions not yet done. Some outstanding questions/actions

1. DevicePluginContainer removed. Need to check no longer referenced.
2. Confirm whether PluginBase, and MavlinkHandlerTableEntry part of the public API? If so need docs for those.
3. Device needs docs: https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/243

@julianoes Even though this is not "complete", provided it is accurate as is, it might be worth accepting and then doing how to write plugins etc as separate PRs.

## [v0.4.0](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/tree/v0.4.0) (2018-04-26)

[Full Changelog](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0)

**Implemented enhancements:**

- Rename "Mavlink" stuffs to that of "MAVLink" [\#329](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/329)
- Support for `COMMAND\_INT` [\#326](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/326)
- Return vectors by value in C++11 [\#319](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/319)
- Class name change: Device to System [\#318](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/318)
- Choosing reference over pointer [\#314](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/314)
- Add support to include Doxygen tags \code and \endcode [\#259](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/259)
- Rename `camera\_action\_delay\_s` to `loiter\_time\_s` in MissionItem class [\#249](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/249)
- Connection URL for DroneCore applications [\#244](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/244)
- FollowMeImpl::set\_config\(\) returns immediately though Device didn't confirm [\#221](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/221)
- Cross-compile the backend for iOS [\#213](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/213)
- Cross-compile the backend for Android [\#212](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/212)
- Have one gRPC server library for each plugin [\#211](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/211)
- Dynamically load plugins in dronecore\_server [\#210](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/210)
- device.h should become a library [\#209](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/209)
- Build core as a library [\#208](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/208)
- Build each plugin in its own library [\#207](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/207)
- Clarify FollowMe::Config::min\_height\_m and follow\_dist\_m  [\#204](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/204)
- Exposing Flight mode APIs in core/device\_impl.h [\#193](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/193)
- FollowMe API feels inconsistent [\#191](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/191)
- Follow Me has no example [\#189](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/189)
- Add public API to control camera outside of missions [\#154](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/154)

- Implement mavlink camera definition [\#126](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/126)

- Improvements to core [\#359](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/pull/359) ([shakthi-prashanth-m](https://github.com/shakthi-prashanth-m))
- Make use of smart pointers and references [\#316](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/pull/316) ([shakthi-prashanth-m](https://github.com/shakthi-prashanth-m))
- Add Follow me example [\#217](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/pull/217) ([shakthi-prashanth-m](https://github.com/shakthi-prashanth-m))

**Fixed bugs:**

- Mission items are not cleared before building them up [\#348](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/348)
- DroneCore application \(GCS\) should NOT mix up with System/Device [\#317](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/317)
- Takeoff example exits before vehicle is ready [\#307](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/issues/307)
